summary: Full-pass test of Body Lab Bali EMR: 32/32 backend pytest tests pass (auth for all 5 roles, RBAC, patient/visit CRUD, clinical+therapist record submit-locking, treatments, photo upload via Emergent Object Storage + signed file serving, mappings, billing calc/total, pending-billing queue, timeline, audit, stats). Frontend: login flow works for all 5 roles, role-aware sidebar verified (FO=Pending Billing, Manager+Admin=Audit, Doctor/Therapist=neither), patient creation, visit creation, all 7 visit tabs render, photo upload works end-to-end through the UI, clinical form (chip-style assessment buttons) renders, audit log table populated, billing calc verified server-side. One non-blocking React warning identified: LoginPage navigates during render.

ui_bugs.issue: Calls nav('/') directly inside the render body when `user` is already authenticated. React logs: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (LoginPage)'. Should be moved into a useEffect hook (or use <Navigate to='/' replace />).

action_items: (Optional/low) Fix LoginPage setState-during-render warning by replacing `if (user) { nav('/') }` with a useEffect or <Navigate to='/' replace />.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py @app.on_event('startup')/'shutdown') uses deprecated FastAPI hooks; consider lifespan context manager (non-blocking).

server.py CORS: allow_origins=['*'] together with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec; browsers will reject credentialed requests. Currently the frontend uses Bearer tokens so this works, but cookie-based auth (httpOnly cookie is set on /api/auth/login) will not work cross-origin. Either set allow_credentials=False or replace '*' with explicit origin.

/api/files/{path} accepts the JWT in a query param (?auth=...) which leaks the token into server access logs and browser history. Consider a short-lived signed URL or returning a separate file-access token.
PatientIn validation: empty body still allowed because every field is Optional except full_name; OK for now but date_of_birth has no format validation.
BillingIn.items is List[Dict[str, Any]] (no schema validation) — client can pass arbitrary keys.
MappingIn.image_data is base64 stored directly in MongoDB document; large face mappings can exceed Mongo 16MB doc limit. Should be uploaded via object storage.
Frontend: /api/auth/me errors do not redirect to /login on 401 token expiry — token exists in localStorage but API returns 401; ensure axios interceptor handles auth refresh/redirect.

success_rate.frontend: ~96% (one minor React warning, all functional flows pass)

test_credentials: All demo accounts password=password123 — admin@bodylab.id, doctor@bodylab.id, therapist@bodylab.id, fo@bodylab.id, manager@bodylab.id. Stored in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Test created TEST_-prefixed patients/visits/clinical/therapist/billing records. Did not delete (DB is dev). No production data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints verified end-to-end via /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`). Photos upload uses Emergent Object Storage which IS reachable from this preview env. The `submit=true` flag is the standard pattern for locking clinical/therapist records. Visit status transitions: in_progress -> submitted (after clinical/therapist submit) -> billed (after billing payment_status=paid). Frontend post-login route is `/` (not `/dashboard`); the Dashboard component is mounted at `/`. Treatments tab does NOT show the Add form for FO role (only doctor/therapist/super_admin) — this is correct per backend RBAC. Doctor visit detail correctly hides Therapist & Billing tabs.
rca_of_the_issue: LoginPage.jsx line 22 calls navigate('/') during render synchronously when an authenticated user lands on /login. React forbids triggering parent-state updates inside a render. Fix: wrap in useEffect(() => { if (user) nav('/') }, [user, nav]) or replace with `if (user) return <Navigate to='/' replace />;`.
